subject: [PATCH 06/10] mm/madvise: separate huge PMDs from the PTE walk

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch separates the handling of huge PMDs from the PTE walk in the madvise_lru_pmd_entry function. It introduces a new helper function, madvise_lru_huge_pmd, which is responsible for handling huge PMDs and returns false when a requested split requires a PTE walk. The patch moves the lock ownership and splitting of huge PMDs into this dedicated helper, making the code more modular and easier to understand.
